comments.body: @billpranty Yeah, it was in the grass of the parking lot.
@tgonye23 Hi Thomas: is the location correct: at the end of Pa-Hay-Okee Overlook?
@joemdo I did, currently still waiting for it to be confirmed.
Oh, awesome! Hope it gets approved soon... phenomenal find!!
@tgonye23 please consider posting to eBird, as this would be the first record for Miami-Dade County!
Thanks for sharing and great work documenting such a rare bird down here :-)
@tgonye23 Hi Tom, would you please fill out an FOSRC Rare Bird Form for the Harris's? Thank much.  https://www.fosbirds.org/rarebirdreports.html

@billpranty Just filled it out, thanks for sending it my way. 
@joemdo Looks like the observation was confirmed on eBird. [Here's](https://ebird.org/checklist/S124381412) the checklist!

This one stumped me, I've been sitting in front of my field guides trying to turn it into one of the expected species, since I'm not from the area I don't really know what I'm looking at. Harris' actually looks pretty good, though.
